fl01_ne5532.notes: 2-bit noise synth on a plain white full-size board, near top-down, sharp. No printed row letters; faint embossed column numbers at the left end read ...63 62 61... (upside down), so column 1 is the right-hand end and row a is taken as the top (a-e) half. The board has 64 hole columns: the leftmost column is outside the app's 63-column grid (nothing is in it), as in eval/e02. Taps: a1/j1 on the rightmost column, a63/j63 on the second column from the left. The rails are split in the middle (columns 34/31) and bridged by short loops. Rail signs are not printed; the supply leads at the right end suggest a-side outer -, inner +, j-side inner -, outer + (not used: rails left "?"). Many wires leave the frame (to the power supply and the controls); those ends are "off". LDRs, the jack and the slide switch hide their pins.

ON MC14093BCP 14-pin quad NAND: not an op-amp. Notch/dimple at the column-10 end, so pin 1 = f10.

fl02_lm358_top.notes: LM358 on a 30-column half board, near top-down with moderate perspective (camera over the near end). Printed labels: column 1 at the bottom, row a on the right, column 30 at the top. a1 sits just under the out-of-focus clip at the bottom right: that tap is placed from the visible grid (row 1 b-e and column a rows 2-5). Circuit: op-amp B wired as a follower (pins 6-7 bridged, red lead out from pin 7), its + input pulled to the + rail through R1; pin 8 to +, pin 4 to -.

fl06_ne555_neg.notes: "Traffic Lights": two NE555 timers on a transparent 30-column half board, near top-down, sharp but very cluttered (about 17 flexible jumpers with black boots). Printed labels: column 1 at the right, row a on top. The taps are on the visible hole slots (a transparent board: the slots read a little inboard of the printed numbers at the ends). a30 is under the red and blue wires: its tap is placed from the visible grid (b30-e30 and row a 27-29). NEGATIVE CASE: both chips are 555 timers and must not be built as a TL072. Most wire ends are boots whose pin is hidden; each boot end is read from where the boot stands (conf low/med). The blue wires cross in a tangle round the red LED (columns 3-12): their far ends could not be paired, so those wires are listed with one end and "?".

wm03_oscillator.notes: "Final product Oscillator": a 63-column board lying lengthwise in the frame. The file is stored sideways (EXIF orientation 6, raw 2592x1936): labelled in the upright 1936x2592 frame the browser shows (Chrome applies EXIF on decode; the page taps in img.naturalWidth/Height, which are the oriented size). Printed labels: column 1 at the bottom, column 63 at the top, row a on the right, row j on the left. Chips are small in frame and blurred: no pin-1 notch or dot is readable on any of them, and no marking. Two 14-pin DIPs (columns 46-40 and 32-26) and one 8-pin DIP (columns 19-16); the manifest guessed two 8-pin and one 14-pin, but counting the pins gives two 14-pin. Most short jumpers follow the pre-cut kit colour code by length (red 2, orange 3...). Rail columns are approximate (the rail holes sit between body columns and the rails have gaps every 5); only the strip counts for scoring.
